## Motivation

Exposes new discovery fields to `api.v1` clients.

## Modifications

New fields:
- In `GetServerInfoResponse`:
    - `allow_auto_truncate` - to allow truncation of long prompts (instead of rejeciton)
    - `skip_tokenizer_init` - launch server without tokenizer
    - `num_reserved_tokens` - exact context-window budget under speculative decoding
    - Note: HTTP `/server_info` also gains `num_reserved_tokens`; it already carried `allow_auto_truncate` and `skip_tokenizer_init` from the launch args.
- In `GetModelInfoResponse`:
    - `model_type` - model family
    - `architectures` - HF architecture
- `DeploymentInfo.hicache_host_total_tokens` reports the KV host pool's realized capacity instead of `null`. The tree cache, host pools included, is built before the Rust server launches.

## Tests

CPU, on this branch (base `main` at `8cd3c494a3`):
- `cargo gen-api`: no diff. `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo test --workspace`: 547 passed, 0 failed, including the new `server_info_reports_launch_facts_for_orchestrators` and the extended `/model_info` route test.
- `cargo package -p sglang-api-types --offline`: OK.
- `test/registered/unit/api/v1/test_parity.py`: 9 passed (44 subtests). `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_rust_server_dp_ports.py`: 32 passed.
- `pre-commit` on the changed files: passed.

End to end on H100 (earlier base `7d9bc10493`, same change): Dynamo's SGLang sidecar read these fields over api.v1 in its aggregated, disaggregated and KV-router tests, 4/4 passed.

Not applicable: this PR adds discovery metadata and does not change model outputs.

## Checklist

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
